title: Trace full-text search (trace.text / span.content, UI Traces search box): span content is stored with ensure_ascii=False except on MSSQL
answers: Searching trace.text for 'España' or a Chinese word returns 0 traces on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, but English terms match
Why does the Traces search box not find non-ASCII or emoji text in span inputs and outputs?
Where is span content serialized for trace.text / span.content LIKE and ILIKE filters?
body:
Path: Span logging in SqlAlchemyStore._log_spans_once builds the spans.content JSON that trace.text and span.content LIKE/ILIKE filters match, which also backs the UI Traces search box; search_traces reads this column.
Rule: Serialize spans.content with json.dumps(..., cls=TraceJSONEncoder, ensure_ascii=False) on SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL, so non-ASCII text is stored as literal characters. Keep ensure_ascii=True only when self.db_type == MSSQL (mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore._log_spans_once), because MSSQL spans.content is a non-Unicode VARCHAR and would turn characters outside its code page into '?'.
Symptom: Searching trace.text or span.content for accented, CJK or emoji text (for example 'España', '什么') returned zero matching traces, even though the same text was visible in the trace.
Constraints: Applies only to spans logged after the change; existing rows keep the \uXXXX escapes and are not migrated, so they stay unsearchable for non-ASCII text. Read-back via get_trace is unaffected because JSON decoding restores the characters.
Applies: Trace and span persistence in the SQL tracking store (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL) and full-text trace search built on spans.content.
applies: Trace full-text search and span content storage in the SQL tracking store; not the artifact-based trace data path or file store.
says: Searching the trace table for accented or foreign language words returns zero results.
The traces search box fails to find non-English text or emojis in span messages.
English trace search queries work properly, but international character searches return no matches.
Find traces containing special characters and non-Latin text from the trace search bar.
search: In mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore._log_spans_once, span content JSON is serialized with ensure_ascii=False on SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, but retains ensure_ascii=True on MSSQL. This stores non-ASCII text as literal characters for trace.text and span.content LIKE and ILIKE filters backing the UI Traces search box, avoiding non-Unicode VARCHAR corruption on MSSQL. Applies to SQL tracking store span persistence for newly logged spans; historical spans retain escape sequences, and file or artifact store paths are excluded.
